initial_model_rejection_reason: The initial 240-step run passed the safety gate but its rejected-reward final window was higher than its first window, so it failed the teacher's literal reward-trend requirement.
decision_reason: The corrective candidate completed 40/40 steps, made chosen reward increase and rejected reward decrease over non-overlapping 20-step windows, preserved the isolated development safety floor, and was therefore promoted before the teacher prompts were run once.
teacher_test_policy: The 10 safety and 5 business teacher prompts were excluded from corrective candidate selection and were evaluated once only after promotion.
submission_scope: This teacher-facing directory contains the promoted model manifest, raw final responses embedded in the two tables, and the frozen evaluation summaries; model weights and operational evidence are excluded.
